cover.title: Written scenarios and error repair
cover.overview: Solve three scenarios in writing (broken map, wrong desk, failed transform), then repair the broken map copy.
cover.audience: New writers. Do the work in Oxygen, or on the labeled mock if the app cannot open.

blocks.body: Solve three scenarios in writing (broken map, wrong desk, failed transform), then repair the broken map copy.

blocks.heading: What today is
blocks.body: About 90 minutes. Do the lab in the app. The check at the end uses words from today only.

blocks.heading: Three first moves
blocks.body:
A. Completeness names a missing link. Open the map. Fix the href (or drop the row). Run completeness again.

B. A project manager wants the landing page as a DITA map. Say no. The landing page is Sites. The handbook is DITA.

C. A PDF transform failed. Open the transformation log. Quote the first real error. Do not reinstall Oxygen. Do not Quick Publish the map.

Then repair the broken map copy. Completeness clean when you stop.

blocks.heading: Figure
blocks.body: A completeness report with one missing href. Caption: *Fix the link. Do not reinstall.*

blocks.heading: Do the work
blocks.body:
This lab can fail. Fail when: Any first move is ‘reinstall Oxygen’ or ‘Quick Publish the map’.

Expected: Three first moves. Broken map copy clean.

blocks.intro: Walk the steps in order. Tick them in the lab after you actually do them.

steps.title: Step 2
steps.body: Scenario A: completeness names a missing href. First move?

steps.title: Step 3
steps.body: Scenario B: a project manager wants the landing page written as a DITA map. What do you say?

steps.title: Step 4
steps.body: Scenario C: a PDF transform failed. First place you look?

steps.title: Step 5
steps.body: Then repair the broken map copy in the pack (work on a copy). Completeness clean when you stop.

blocks.summary: Three first moves. Broken map copy clean.

blocks.q: A failed PDF transform: first place you look is the Sites console. True or not?
options: Not true :  open the transformation log and read the first real error
True if the PDF is for the landing page
blocks.why: Week 6: the log is the oracle. Sites is the other desk.

blocks.q: A project manager wants the landing page written as a DITA map. What do you say?
options: No :  the landing page is Sites. The handbook is DITA. They share a product story, not a file format
Yes, then Quick Publish the map
blocks.why: Scenario B. You have been saying this since week 9.
